tools.name: catalog
tools.description: List the tools of this server with prices, data sources, licensing, daily limits and data freshness.

tools.name: organic_jas_lookup
tools.description: Is this operator in Japan's official MAFF list of organic JAS certified operators (domestic or foreign)? Look up by certification number, operator name (2+ chars, organizations only), country, prefecture, category or certifier. Returns found, no_longer_listed (reason not published or inferred), no_m

tools.name: organic_jas_changes
tools.description: Which organic JAS listings were added to, changed in, dropped from or returned to MAFF's official lists since a date? From this service's own record of list versions (MAFF keeps no old files). Each change has the listing id, observed_at, last_seen_at, changed fields and before/after; personal-lookin

tools.name: get_receipt
tools.description: Re-fetch the stored result of a settled paid call by its receipt_id, for when the response was lost after payment. Free. Unknown or unsettled receipt ids return RECEIPT_NOT_FOUND. Results are kept for 90 days after settlement.
